about: Parity corpus for scripts/complexity_gate_py.py. radon values are frozen from radon 6.0.1 (generated once in a scratch venv outside the repository; radon is not a project dependency). expected is the owner ruling of 2026-10-12 (ESLint 9.39.2 and NIST SP 500-235 4.1). Where expected differs from radon, divergence says why.
